subject: Model handback: customer exemption lane & comms plan
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Long <sarah.long@fjordanalytics.com>, Tim Fletcher <tim.fletcher@fjordanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Model handback: customer exemption lane & comms plan

Hi Sarah / Tim —

Thanks again for the sync earlier — quick follow up from our product/ops side on the planned handback of the inference-v1 family. As discussed, the public sunset for inference-v1 is scheduled for 2028-04-30. Fjord has a set of production pipelines that will break unless we provide a short-term compatibility path.

What we need from you by COB next Tuesday (2028-03-06):
- Confirmation of the endpoints and rate patterns you depend on (list OK)
- Callouts for any regulatory constraints or contractual clauses (we saw a mention of audit retention in the contract)

Internal ask: Marissa / Ben / Lauren — can we designate an exception seat for Fjord (3-month bridge with limited SLA and reduced throughput) and draft the comms plus a mutual action plan (MAP)? I attached a proposed calendar and MAP template to start.

High-level plan I propose:
1) Customer acceptance window (Mar 7–Mar 21) — compatibility tests and smoke tests
2) Exception seat activation (Mar 22) — temporary routing to inference-v1-compat shim with throttled quotas
3) Sunset cutover (Apr 30) — final migration or contract addendum

If we can lock internal owners for each step today I can share a short customer-facing note.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwood.ai
Att: 2028-03-01-handback-calendar.pdf; Fjord-MAP-template.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model handback: customer exemption lane & comms plan

Chloe — thanks for the clear plan. Quick notes from product/ops:

- Product: We can validate the shim (inference-v1-compat) but it adds ~7% tail-latency for long contexts; need to put that in the customer note.
- Capacity: Ben, can you confirm we have the spare slot on the dedicated pool for a 3-month seat starting Mar 22? If not, we should offer a reduced throughput SLA.
- Comms: Marcus, I need a one-pager for execs that summarizes risks and mitigation (2 bullets max).

I'll take the MAP and populate the product acceptance criteria. Chloe — can you ask Fjord to provide a reference traffic sample (even a 24-hr gzip) so we can run a quick size-of-state test?

Marissa
Director, Product | Redwood Inference

All — checked capacity and quick answer: we can host a single exception seat on a shared reserved host (low-priority) starting Mar 22, but throughput will be capped at 120 RPS and we cannot guarantee the standard p99 SLA. That fits the 3-month window. To make this work we need:
- Signed exception addendum (legal) before activation
- Scheduling notice to infra (72 hours) and a brief runbook for the CS team

I've added a short attachment to the internal drive runbook (link in related_links). If Fjord needs a higher throughput we should talk price/commit.

Ben
Head of Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: Model handback: customer exemption lane & comms plan

Sarah / Tim —

Appreciate the quick responses. A few concrete next steps from our side:
- We (Redwood) will prepare an exception addendum for signature that limits throughput to 120 RPS and marks the SLA as "best-effort" for the bridge period. Legal is looped.
- Product will run a compatibility test once you upload a representative traffic sample (per Marissa's ask).
- We'll enable the exception seat on Mar 22 pending signed addendum and infra scheduling.

Can you confirm you are comfortable with the throttled throughput and the temporary SLA? Also please share the traffic sample link (S3 or Drive) and any contract clauses you want us to reference.

Chloe
